rule: D-03 any divergence forces SAFE_MODE; D-15 operator-only exit; D097; 20D-37; R-15
summary: One compared tick with one divergence latches durable SAFE_MODE, and a healthy trade passes through snapshots the compare reports (fill before stop confirmed, TP1 acked before COMPLETE, exchange flat before coordinator FLAT, GTD expiry). D097 covers only a fill during the placement task.
expected: A healthy trade lifecycle never needs an operator action; SAFE_MODE means something is wrong.
actual: Probe cases S1-S7 all return divergences that classify to SAFE_MODE; the protection task and the reconcile task are independent scheduler loops; the only mitigation is the skip at src/live/wiring.py:1064 while a placement task is outstanding.
impact: Entries blocked until /safemode_exit after ordinary fills and exits (rough estimate W/15 s per trade, 20-40 % for W of 3-6 s); false UNPROTECTED_POSITION alerts; operator learns to exit by habit. No direct money loss.
evidence: loop.py:782-788; compare.py:680-695, 718-734; local_intent.py:104-118; src/live/wiring.py:1062-1066, 1126-1133; src/execution/manager.py:2338; docs/DECISIONS.md:101 (D097); tmp/reconcile_safemode/probe_transients.out
why_tests_miss: tests pin only the placement-task skip; reconcile tests use settled states; the Demo smoke entry fills at placement
recommendation: Owner choice: require two consecutive ticks or a minimum age; or a transition-aware local side; or one lock for protection step and reconcile reads; or latch only non-transient kinds. Measure the windows on Demo first.
known_prior: PARTLY KNOWN: D097, 20-DEFERRED 20D-37, 24-DEFERRED R-15 (single instances; 20D-37 understated)

category: reconcile / SAFE_MODE latch / single failed read
rule: loop docstring fail-closed rule; D-15; D072 sdk_retries = 0
summary: One failed truth read (any exception of one of three GETs per 15 s tick, no retry) enters durable SAFE_MODE API_DEGRADATION that only the operator can leave.
expected: A single failed GET skips the compare of that tick; SAFE_MODE follows a sustained failure.
actual: 17,280 unretried reads a day; one failure latches SAFE_MODE (also one UNKNOWN-entry step error, one unreadable feed).
impact: At 99.99 % read success about 1.7 false SAFE_MODE latches a day; entries blocked until a human exits.
reproduction: code read; the loop tests assert this behaviour
why_tests_miss: tests assert the latch as intended; no soak measures real read failure rates
recommendation: Owner number N of consecutive failed ticks before SAFE_MODE, or let a clean tick withdraw API_DEGRADATION / STALE_FEED.

rule: D-14, F-127, F-606: a restart must never read SAFE_MODE as off
summary: When the journal write of a SAFE_MODE entry fails, the state save is not attempted; journal and state store are the same database, so SAFE_MODE entered during a database outage is lost by a restart before a later enter call saves it.
expected: SAFE_MODE entered in one process is on in the next process.
actual: Probe: process A in_safe_mode True, persisted None, spill has SAFE_MODE_ENTER; process B after restart in_safe_mode False.
impact: Reasons that leave no other state (STREAM_SINK_FAILURE incl. rejected triggered stop, AUTH_FAILURE, API_DEGRADATION, STALE_FEED) vanish; entries can resume without the operator exit. Narrowed by startup recovery, the first reconcile tick and human enable on LIVE.
why_tests_miss: tests check the in-memory flag and the in-process retry; none restarts between the failed save and the retry
recommendation: Attempt the save even when the journal write failed, and start in SAFE_MODE when the spill holds an entry record newer than the loaded state.

category: SAFE_MODE exit path outside the controller
rule: D-15: exit_safe_mode is the only way out of SAFE_MODE
summary: An owner script appends in_safe_mode False directly to the system-state log with none of the seven exit rows; it is bound to Demo only by an environment variable and a typed phrase.
expected: Every persisted SAFE_MODE-off comes from the controller, or the bypass is technically bound to a Demo database.
actual: Guards: LIVE_RUNTIME_MODE env var, phrase, unresolved-intent count. No check of the database identity or of Binance.
impact: Now: Demo convenience. Mainnet: the durable latch can be removed without any exchange check if the script is pointed at the live database.
why_tests_miss: no test of the script's guard against a non-Demo database
recommendation: Bind to a mode marker stored in the database, or drop the SAFE_MODE write and use /safemode_exit.
